package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const largeChartCaption = "Synthetic chart-scale task: grade A = 1,000; find_symbol calls = 1,234,567; references calls = 1,000."

func largeChartModel() observatoryModel {
	m := observatoryGuideModel("complete")
	zero := 0
	m.Services = make([]obsServiceRow, 1000)
	for i := range m.Services {
		name := fmt.Sprintf("synthetic-%04d", i+1)
		m.Services[i] = obsServiceRow{
			fleetServiceRow: fleetServiceRow{
				Service: name, Symbols: 1, Freshness: "fresh",
				OpenObservations: &zero, SessionCount: &zero,
			},
			Grade: "A", Realization: &realizationReport{Service: name, Grade: "A", Realized: 5, Available: 5},
		}
	}
	m.Misses = []obsMissRow{
		{Tool: "find_symbol", Calls: 1234567, Hits: 1234567},
		{Tool: "references", Calls: 1000, Hits: 1000},
	}
	return m
}

func largeChartDocument(scheme string) (string, error) {
	if scheme != "light" && scheme != "dark" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown scheme %q", scheme)
	}
	body, err := disableObservatoryGuideLinks(`<p id="large-chart-task" class="mb-4 text-ink-muted">` +
		html.EscapeString(largeChartCaption) + `</p>` + renderObsFleet(largeChartModel()))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return `<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="` + scheme + `"><head><meta charset="utf-8">` +
		`<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Fathom large chart fixture</title>` +
		`<link rel="stylesheet" href="/app.css"></head>` +
		`<body class="min-h-screen bg-surface font-sans text-sm text-ink"><main id="observatory-main" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl p-4">` +
		body + `</main></body></html>`, nil
}

func TestAppKitLargeChartModel(t *testing.T) {
	m := largeChartModel()
	if len(m.Services) != 1000 || len(m.Misses) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture cardinality = %d services, %d call rows", len(m.Services), len(m.Misses))
	}
	for _, row := range m.Services {
		if row.Realization == nil || row.Realization.Grade != "A" || row.Grade != "A" {
			t.Fatalf("non-A synthetic service: %#v", row)
		}
	}
	page, err := largeChartDocument("light")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{
		largeChartCaption,
		`aria-label="grade distribution on 2026-09-21"`,
		`aria-label="calls per tool"`,
		`width="256"`, `width="560"`, "1,234,567", "1,000",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(page, want) {
			t.Fatalf("large fixture missing %q", want)
		}
	}
	for _, absent := range []string{"<a ", "<table", "fleet coverage unavailable", "unknown scheme"} {
		if strings.Contains(page, absent) {
			t.Fatalf("large fixture contains unexpected %q", absent)
		}
	}
	if _, err := largeChartDocument("unknown"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown scheme accepted")
	}
}

func TestAppKitLargeChartFixture(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("APPKIT_LARGE_CHART_FIXTURE") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set APPKIT_LARGE_CHART_FIXTURE=1 for the isolated browser fixture")
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	origin := "http://" + listener.Addr().String()
	guide, err := observatoryGuideMux(origin)
	if err != nil {
		listener.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	allowed := func(r *http.Request) bool {
		host, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
		peer := net.ParseIP(host)
		return splitErr == nil && peer != nil && peer.IsLoopback() && r.Host == listener.Addr().String() &&
			(r.Header.Get("Origin") == "" || r.Header.Get("Origin") == origin)
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/dev/theme", guide)
	mux.Handle("/dev/theme/", guide)
	mux.HandleFunc("/app.css", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !allowed(r) {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
			_, _ = w.Write(obsAppCSS)
		}
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/large", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !allowed(r) {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		if r.URL.RawQuery != "scheme=light" && r.URL.RawQuery != "scheme=dark" {
			http.Error(w, "scheme must be exactly light or dark", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		document, renderErr := largeChartDocument(strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.RawQuery, "scheme="))
		if renderErr != nil {
			http.Error(w, "fixture render refused", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'none'; img-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(document))
		}
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 3 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout: 15 * time.Second, MaxHeaderBytes: 16 << 10,
	}
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- server.Serve(listener) }()
	fmt.Printf("APPKIT_LARGE_CHART_ORIGIN=%s\n", origin)
	timer := time.NewTimer(180 * time.Second)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
	case <-timer.C:
	case serveErr := <-done:
		if !errors.Is(serveErr, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			t.Fatalf("fixture server stopped early: %v", serveErr)
		}
		return
	}
	shutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := server.Shutdown(shutdown); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
		t.Fatalf("fixture server cleanup: %v", err)
	}
}
